The Head of Engineering is responsible for leading the Engineering function and contributing to the overall engineering strategy. This role ensures the effective delivery of Manufacturing Engineering, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Continuous Improvement initiatives in alignment with customer, regulatory, and industry standards.

* Establish and maintain engineering processes, procedures, and standards.
* Prepare and manage the Engineering department budget.
* Provide regular performance reporting to senior leadership.
* Identify and escalate risks, issues, or events that may impact business performance.

* Support Operations and project teams with engineering expertise.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with customer, regulatory, and industry standards.
* Partner with Sales to provide technical input for new business opportunities.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across engineering functions.
* Implement performance monitoring systems to track engineering quality and efficiency.
* Promote a culture of innovation, learning, and peer review.
* Contribute to the development and execution of the company"s technology roadmap.
* Evaluate and implement emerging technologies relevant to aerospace, defense, and industrial markets.
* Introduce new manufacturing and engineering capabilities using maturity models (e.g., MRL/MCRL).
* Ensure proper documentation and protection of intellectual property and technical knowledge.
* Promote knowledge sharing across cross-functional teams.

* Strong leadership and team management experience within engineering environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex projects.
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, processes, and performance metrics.
* Experience managing budgets and reporting to senior leadership.
* Ability to identify risks and implement effective mitigation strategies.
* 10-12+ years of progressive experience in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or NPI roles.
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing multi-disciplinary engineering teams.
* Proven track record of introducing new products and manufacturing technologies.
* Experience with strategic technology planning and innovation roadmaps.
* Hands-on experience with regulatory and industry standards (AS9100, ISO9001, NADCAP, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications:
* Experience in Aerospace, Defense, or Industrial manufacturing environments.
* Familiarity with New Product Introduction (NPI) and manufacturing engineering processes.
* Experience driving continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Knowledge of industry standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and NADCAP.
* Certifications in Quality (e.g., Six Sigma) or Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2).
* Master"s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical discipline.

added.title: Senior Technical Director, Hydrometallurgy & Mineral Processing Engineering
added.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking a Senior Technical Director, Hydrometallurgy & Mineral Processing Engineering
to join our South Jordan, Utah
office. This senior technical role will provide subject matter leadership for hydrometallurgical and mineral processing projects from concept and front-end development through scoping, pre-feasibility, feasibility, detailed execution, commissioning, and operational support.

The successful candidate will lead process engineering teams, shape technically robust flowsheets, direct laboratory and integrated pilot programs, and translate test results into practical process designs. The role combines hands-on technical work, project planning, client engagement, quality oversight, mentoring, proposal support, and collaboration with multidisciplinary study and execution teams.

The position will support projects involving lithium, uranium, vanadium, rare earth elements, copper, cobalt, zinc, and other base or critical minerals. The Senior Technical Director will work in office, laboratory, pilot-plant, and site environments and may lead teams across multiple locations and cultures.

Your Impact

Provide senior technical direction for hydrometallurgical and mineral processing studies and execution assignments, ensuring work is technically sound, fit for purpose, and aligned with agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
Lead development and review of design criteria, metallurgical balances, process flow diagrams, process descriptions, equipment lists, equipment selection and sizing, and process and piping documentation.
Develop, evaluate, and optimize hydrometallurgical flowsheets incorporating leaching, pressure oxidation, atmospheric leaching, resin-in-pulp, resin-in-leach, carbon-in-pulp, ion exchange, solvent extraction, precipitation, electrowinning, and membrane or nanofiltration technologies, as applicable.
Direct laboratory test work and integrated continuous pilot campaigns, including test planning, vendor or laboratory coordination, data analysis, interpretation of results, and definition of design inputs and scale-up criteria.
Apply process simulation and mass-balancing tools, including Aspen-based simulation and spreadsheet models, to evaluate process alternatives, utilities, reagents, recoveries, recycle streams, and operating performance.
Lead process contributions to concept, scoping, pre-feasibility, and feasibility studies, including process trade-off studies, technology selection, risk identification, capital and operating cost inputs, and technical report preparation.
Support project execution, equipment installation, commissioning, ramp-up, troubleshooting, and process optimization for new and existing facilities.
Identify and assess novel technologies and opportunities to apply existing technologies in innovative flowsheets, balancing technical maturity, operability, safety, environmental considerations, and economic value.
Act as a senior client interface by presenting findings, addressing technical concerns, communicating progress and decisions, and building trusted relationships with clients, laboratories, technology providers, vendors, and project partners.
Prepare and review technical proposals, scopes of work, study reports, design deliverables, technical papers, and presentations for client and professional audiences.
Mentor and coach process engineers and technical staff, promote sound engineering judgment, and strengthen consistent work practices, knowledge sharing, and quality review across project teams.
Work with project managers and discipline leaders to develop execution strategies, realistic work plans, budgets, schedules, staffing plans, and risk mitigation actions for large or complex assignments.
Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities, supporting client engagement, developing repeat work, and positioning WSP capabilities in hydrometallurgy and critical-minerals processing.
Apply WSP administrative, financial, quality, safety, ethical, and professional conduct requirements in all project and field activities.

Core Technical Competencies

Hydrometallurgical flowsheet development and optimization from bench-scale testwork through pilot campaigns and commercial implementation.
Process design for leaching, solution purification, ion exchange, solvent extraction, precipitation, electrowinning, resin and carbon circuits, and membrane or nanofiltration applications.
Metallurgical accounting, mass and solution balances, process simulation, equipment sizing, and interpretation of laboratory and pilot data.
Critical- and base-minerals processing, with relevant experience in commodities such as lithium, uranium, vanadium, rare earth elements, copper, cobalt, and zinc.
Technology evaluation, process trade-off studies, scale-up, commissioning, operational troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
Technical leadership across study, engineering, execution, and commissioning phases, including multidisciplinary interface management.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, mineral processing, metallurgical engineering, mining engineering, or a closely related discipline.
More than 20 years of relevant process engineering and hydrometallurgical experience, including leadership of complex studies or execution assignments.
Demonstrated experience taking mineral processing projects from concept through feasibility and into execution, commissioning, or operations support.
Substantial experience planning, overseeing, and interpreting laboratory testwork and pilot-scale programs.
Strong scientific and analytical understanding of hydrometallurgy, process design, metallurgical balances, and process optimization.
Experience evaluating or developing technology and integrating novel or established technologies into practical flowsheets.
Proven ability to lead technical teams, plan work, manage schedules and quality, review deliverables, and communicate technical decisions clearly.
Established client-facing experience, including technical presentations, report writing, issue resolution, and relationship development.
Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, exercise mature technical judgment, and know when broader specialist or project leadership input is required.
Commitment to mentoring and developing engineers and technical staff and to working effectively with diverse, geographically distributed teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to prepare clear, defensible technical reports and proposals.
Commitment to workplace safety and ability to comply with WSP health, safety, drug and alcohol, harassment, ethics, and conduct requirements.
Ability to travel occasionally to laboratories, pilot facilities, client offices, and project sites, including remote locations, and to work schedules suited to project requirements.
Must successfully complete and pass WSP motor vehicle screening where driving is required.

Preferred Qualifications

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson is seeking a Senior Manager, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) AI Engineering
to lead AI innovation, engineering, and delivery across SAP S/4HANA transformation programs supporting MedTech, Innovative Medicine, and Enterprise Finance, based in Raritan, NJ.

This role will lead the SAP BTP AI Engineering capability and be responsible for advancing the ERP AI Software Development Lifecycle (AI SDLC)—developing and scaling critical Generative AI and agentic AI capabilities that accelerate engineering productivity, S/4 transformation outcomes, and Technology Services (TS) value realization goals.

The Senior Manager will drive innovation across SAP Business AI, Joule, Joule Agents, BTP, Generative AI, AI-assisted software engineering, and agentic AI, while partnering with SAP, strategic technology providers, external vendors, and internal engineering organizations to bring emerging capabilities into enterprise-scale adoption.

Key Responsibilities

SAP BTP AI Engineering & S/4 Transformation

Lead SAP BTP AI Engineering supporting S/4HANA transformation initiatives across MedTech, Innovative Medicine, and Enterprise Finance.
Drive architecture, development, engineering standards, reusable services, and delivery frameworks for enterprise AI solutions built on SAP BTP.
Partner with S/4 transformation teams to identify, prioritize, develop, and scale high-value AI use cases.
Ensure AI capabilities progress rapidly from experimentation and proof-of-concept to secure, scalable, production-grade enterprise solutions.
Establish reusable AI engineering patterns that can be leveraged across S/4 programs, products, and business processes.

ERP AI SDLC Innovation

Own and advance the ERP AI SDLC innovation roadmap, transforming how SAP applications are designed, developed, tested, secured, deployed, and maintained.
Identify and develop critical Generative AI capabilities across the ERP software engineering lifecycle.
Drive AI-assisted development capabilities for requirements engineering, architecture, code generation, code modernization, testing, documentation, security analysis, deployment, and application support.
Establish an integrated AI engineering experience across SAP development technologies including ABAP, RAP, CAP, Fiori/UI5, BTP, APIs, integrations, and S/4 extensions.
Explore and operationalize agentic engineering approaches where specialized AI agents can assist engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Define measurable engineering productivity and quality metrics to demonstrate AI SDLC value realization.

Joule & Developer Productivity

Drive adoption and advancement of SAP Joule, Joule for Developers, Joule Agents, SAP Business AI, and related AI productivity capabilities.
Evaluate emerging Joule capabilities and establish enterprise adoption patterns across SAP engineering teams.
Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, engineering quality, speed-to-market, and automation using Joule and complementary AI engineering technologies.
Partner with SAP and internal engineering teams to influence and accelerate capabilities required for enterprise-scale SAP AI development.
Establish measurement frameworks for productivity improvements and realized business value.

Generative & Agentic AI Capabilities

Lead development of critical Generative AI and agentic AI engineering capabilities required by the ERP transformation.
Establish reusable enterprise patterns for LLM integration, RAG, enterprise knowledge, agent orchestration, tool calling, prompt management, evaluation, guardrails, and observability.
Develop secure approaches for AI agents to interact with SAP business processes, APIs, enterprise data, and other applications.
Advance multi-agent and human-in-the-loop architectures where appropriate for complex enterprise workflows.

TS Value Realization

Align the SAP BTP AI Engineering and ERP AI SDLC roadmap with Technology Services value realization objectives.
Translate AI investments into measurable outcomes including engineering productivity, development-cycle reduction, improved quality, faster S/4 delivery, reduced technical debt, increased automation, and lower operating costs.
Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks to quantify the value delivered through AI engineering initiatives.
Identify opportunities where GenAI can materially accelerate major transformation programs and improve overall technology delivery effectiveness.
Partner with technology and business leadership to prioritize AI investments based on measurable enterprise value.

External Innovation & Strategic Partnerships

Establish and manage strategic engineering relationships with SAP and external AI technology vendors and partners.
Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, development platforms, models, frameworks, and engineering tools relevant to SAP and ERP transformation.
Lead joint innovation, pilots, proof-of-concepts, and co-development initiatives with strategic technology partners.
Evaluate build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions for new AI engineering capabilities.
Work with vendors to influence product roadmaps based on enterprise SAP engineering requirements.
Convert successful external innovation into governed, reusable enterprise capabilities rather than isolated experiments.

AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

Ensure AI applications, development tools, and agents comply with enterprise requirements for security, privacy, responsible AI, regulatory compliance, and data governance.
Establish controls for agent authentication, authorization, data access, human oversight, auditability, evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Partner with cybersecurity, architecture, risk, privacy, and compliance organizations to enable responsible adoption of AI within critical ERP environments.

Engineering Leadership

Lead and mentor teams of SAP BTP engineers, AI engineers, architects, developers, and technical leads.
Build a strong engineering culture focused on innovation, experimentation, reusable platforms, automation, and measurable outcomes.
Collaborate across S/4 functional teams, product owners, architecture, platform engineering, security, data, and business organizations.
Communicate AI strategy, technology direction, engineering progress, risks, and value realization to senior leadership.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of technology experience, with significant experience in SAP engineering, enterprise platforms, and large-scale transformation.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Strong experience with SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA, and enterprise application development.
Knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, SAP Business AI, Joule, and AI-assisted software engineering.
Certifications in SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA, AI/ML are highly desirable.
Proven leadership experience managing large-scale SAP transformation programs and engineering teams.
Strong knowledge of SAP Business AI, Joule, Joule Agents, and SAP’s emerging AI ecosystem.
Strong understanding of SAP development technologies including ABAP, RAP, CAP, Fiori/UI5, APIs, integration, and BTP extension architectures.
Experience with AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity platforms, or AI-enabled SDLC transformation.
Experience moving emerging technologies from experimentation and POC through enterprise production adoption.
Demonstrated experience working with major technology vendors and strategic partners.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, security, responsible AI, and technology governance.
Proven ability to lead engineering teams and influence senior stakeholders across complex global organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Joule for Developers, SAP AI Foundation, RAG, vector databases, knowledge graphs, AI agents, multi-agent architectures, MCP/tool integration, AI evaluation, observability, and guardrails is highly desirable.
Experience establishing enterprise AI engineering platforms, reusable AI services, engineering accelerators, developer productivity capabilities, and measurable technology value-realization frameworks is preferred.

Description

Liberty Mutual's US Retail Markets Global Tech Enablement organization is seeking a Director of Technology Strategy & Operations to lead the Strategy & Governance service provider function. GTE consists of five service providers; four deliver technical capability within defined domains, and Strategy & Governance is the horizontal function that connects them. This role owns that function.

You will be the accountable owner for how enterprise-driven technology work enters USRM, how it is coordinated across domains, and how progress is reported to senior leadership. The role spans governance process design, cross-domain program coordination, executive reporting, and technology separation and integration activity supporting mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures. Success depends less on positional authority than on the ability to build trust across domain leadership, architecture, and enterprise partners, and to convert that trust into consistent execution.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Engagement

Build and sustain relationships with technology domain leaders to understand their operating challenges, surface enablement needs, and bring together the right resources and tools to resolve them. Collect and analyze domain feedback to inform GTE strategy and operational improvements. Secure stakeholder alignment and buy-in on enablement initiatives, develop and execute communication plans that keep stakeholders informed while reducing organizational noise, and drive consistency of process and execution across domains.

Strategic Enablement

Develop and optimize processes across USRM Technology, including the design of governance frameworks, operating structures, and best practices that improve efficiency and consistency. Establish data insights and measurement approaches that give leadership visibility into performance and enable informed decision-making and targeted improvement. Lead implementation and adoption of new processes and strategies, including consolidated communications across USRM.

USRM Horizons Management

Own the USRM Horizons process end to end: intake and scope validation with submitters, data quality and governance in partnership with GDS and GCS, Jira board management and automation, ticket cascade to domains, and escalation to protect hard deadlines. Facilitate recurring impact and analysis sessions with Horizon Champions and Architects, and maintain consolidated communication channels for new tickets, due date changes, and requirement changes.

USRM Reporting Support

Own standard operational reporting on USRM technology performance, including MOR, Stability, and IT Fundamentals reporting. Produce executive-level reporting for senior leadership, including Executive Quarterly, LM Strategic Technology Plan Quarterly, and Spotlight materials, translating operational detail into a clear narrative on wins, risks, and progress against organizational goals.

Transformation & Modernization Support

Provide cross-domain coordination and technical program management for major enterprise-driven transformation and modernization initiatives, overseeing planning, coordination, and delivery while managing resource alignment, risk mitigation, and communication.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in technical or business discipline or related experience; Master's Degree preferred.
Generally, more than 10 years related experience in technology strategy, technology operations, governance, or large-scale program management with 5 years in leadership role.
Demonstrated success leading work through influence across organizational boundaries, without direct authority over the delivery teams involved
Experience owning governance or intake processes at enterprise scale, including process design, measurement, and continuous improvement
Proven ability to produce executive-level reporting and communicate complex technical status to senior leadership with clarity and appropriate framing
Strong program and portfolio management capability, including risk identification, dependency management, and escalation judgment
Experience with Jira or comparable work management platforms, including workflow and automation design
Ability to handle confidential and material non-public information with sound judgment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting technology workstreams in mergers, acquisitions, or divestitures, including Technical Service Agreements and pre-close assessment
Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry
Familiarity with cloud platforms, application modernization, and mainframe migration programs
Working knowledge of ITIL practices and IT operational maturity frameworks
Experience building data and reporting capability from fragmented sources

Competencies

Systems thinking across a complex organization. Influence and stakeholder management at senior levels. Comfort with ambiguity and with defining work that arrives unstructured. Bias toward simplification and noise reduction. Sound judgment on when to escalate and when to resolve. Written and verbal communication that adapts from engineering detail to executive summary.

What Makes This Role Distinctive

Most technology leadership roles own a delivery outcome. This one owns the connective tissue: the intake funnel through which enterprise mandates reach USRM, the governance that keeps execution consistent across domains, the measurement that makes performance visible, and the coordination that carries transformation and transaction work across organizational lines. It is a high-visibility seat with direct exposure to senior USRM and enterprise leadership, and a broad view of the entire USRM technology landscape.

The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The Sr. Director of Technology provides strategic leadership and oversight for all district technology initiatives, ensuring the effective integration of technology to support teaching, learning, and operations. This role is responsible for developing and executing a vision for technology that aligns with district goals, managing technology resources, and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications:
Education/Certification:

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (Master’s preferred)
Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, PMP, CETL) preferred Clear and valid Texas driver’s license

Special Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
Knowledge of Skyward, Google Apps, and enterprise technology systems Expertise in computer network, hardware, and software applications Experience in computer applications development and implementation
Ability to manage budgets and personnel, coordinate district functions, and implement policy and procedure
Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills Strategic thinking, project management, and data interpretation skills Ability to analyze complex business needs and develop technical solutions Knowledge of IT governance, cybersecurity, and data privacy regulations

Experience:
Minimum 3 years of experience supervising and managing an information systems department in a school district (preferred)
Five to seven years of progressive technology leadership experience preferred Demonstrated success in managing large-scale technology projects and teams

Major Responsibilities and Duties:
Strategic Leadership & Vision
●    Create and communicate a vision for technology that supports the district’s mission and strategic plan
●    Advise executive leadership on technology trends, risks, and opportunities
●    Network with state and national colleagues (e.g., TCEA, TASA) to stay current with trends and best practices
●    Lead the evaluation and adoption of new technologies to enhance learning and operations

Technology Operations & Management
●    Oversee all technology systems, including networks, devices, software, and security
●    Direct, coordinate, and ensure implementation of infrastructure design, purchasing, installation, and maintenance
●    Manage, direct, and assign priorities and personnel to major projects to achieve district goals
●    Develop and implement district standards and specifications for hardware, software, and networking
●    Maintain hardware and software, ensuring reliable and secure infrastructure
●    Oversee support between the education service center and district staff, including programming and end-user support
●    Direct the use of email, district websites, voicemail, and other communication systems
●    Track technology expenditures and resource allocation

Policy, Compliance, and Reporting
●    Implement policies established by federal and state law, State Board of Education rule, and local board policy
●    Develop and maintain systems of internal controls, emergency and backup procedures, licensing, upgrades, and disaster recovery
●    Ensure compliance with FERPA, COPPA, and cybersecurity standards
●    Compile, maintain, and file all required reports, records, and documents
●    Participate in research and application for technology-related grants or revenue sources

Budget and Inventory
●    Develop and administer the technology budget based on documented needs
●    Ensure cost-effective operations and wise management of funds
●    Coordinate the purchase of all computer hardware, software, and supplies; initiate purchase orders and bids per district policy

Collaboration and Support
●    Work closely with curriculum and instruction teams to support teaching and learning
●    Build positive relationships with district leaders, educators, and staff
●    Provide technical guidance and support for instructional, operational, and administrative technology
●    25% of the job will be oversight and implementation of the Bond Issuance, Bond Projects, and reporting out on progress to the board and community.
●    Plan and coordinate ongoing, purposeful professional development for technology staff
●    Respond to inquiries and deliver high-quality customer service
